question: Where is the nearest restaurant along the corridor from Art Clinic, New York, NY to Stanford in New York Center, New York, NY?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Art Clinic%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Stanford in New York Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ), corridor_line AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(ST_Centroid(s.geometry), ST_Centroid(e.geometry)) AS geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ), buffered_corridor AS ( -- Create a 50-meter buffer around the corridor line SELECT ST_Buffer(geom::geography, 50)::geometry AS geom FROM corridor_line ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city, p.amenity, p.cuisine FROM pois p WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_corridor)::geography) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM corridor_line)::geography) LIMIT 1;
